label: X11 analysis (plan 2a624b5, scoring amendment A1, analysis R1; exploratory, dev only, outcome-free)

criteria_from_plan.A1: padding value: with air padding the z-fix change keeps >= 50% of its axis-0 shift and of delta lbar_1, same sign; otherwise the padding value is a primary driver
criteria_from_plan.A2: padding amount: total z-fix axis-0 shift = [pad-matched - main] (box filling and cropping at stretched geometry) + [z-fix - pad-matched] (geometry at the same filling); 'geometry drives' if the second part is >= 50% of the total; 'box filling drives' if the first part is >= 70% and the second < 25%
criteria_from_plan.A3: reflect: if reflect padding removes >= 70% of the z-fix shift, the constant slab drives it
criteria_from_plan.A4: decimation: (every-second-slice - main) within +-25% of (z-fix - main) in axis 0 = the bug reproduced with unmodified Sybil; |z-fix - every-second-slice| < 0.5 dev SD = slice overlap itself does not matter
criteria_from_plan.B1: with Sybil's padding, axis 0 and A0 rise with f (slope interval > 0), axis 0 at f = 2.0 >= +2 dev SD, A0 >= +0.20, f = 2.0 > f = 1.25 > 0
criteria_from_plan.B2: axis 0 and A0 positive at f = 2.0 in each of the four makers (delta lbar_1 by maker descriptive)
criteria_from_plan.B3: f = 2.0 pad-matched - true keeps >= 50% of the f = 2.0 axis-0 shift = geometry matters; < 25% = box filling dominates
criteria_from_plan.B4: plateau: among exams already filling the box at f = 2.0, f = 2.5 - f = 2.0 < 0.3 dev SD = saturation (box filling)
criteria_from_plan.B5: (amendment A1) f = 2.0 vs the air-padded true geometry keeps >= 50% of the axis-0 shift vs the Sybil-padded true geometry = the stretch effect does not come from the reference's padding value; < 25% = it does

A1.verdict: the padding value is a primary driver

A3.metric: axis 0 (decided before reading; delta lbar_1 and A0 reported)
A3.verdict: the constant slab drives the z-fix shift

A4.weights: dev maker counts of exams with |ratio - 0.5| < 0.02; makers with < 5 exams in the subset left out
A4.verdict_reproduced: the bug is reproduced with unmodified Sybil
A4.verdict_overlap: slice overlap itself does not matter

B2.rule: interval > 0 for axis 0 and A0 in each maker

B5.verdict: the reference's padding value drives the stretch effect

axis0_distribution.note: axis 0 = (activation - dev mean) / dev SD of the frozen shared axis 0; dev arrays assembled from the cloud runs
